info.title: call4me API
info.description: Phone calls an AI agent places for its user: call a business, follow the call to its outcome, answer the caller's questions mid-call, and patch the user in. Also the prepaid balance, the caller profile, scheduled calls, the account's phone numbers and call recordings. The same operations as the MCP server at /mcp. Calls are billed per minute from pickup (phone menus and conversation; hold time at half price) from the prepaid balance; unanswered calls are free. Refusals name MCP tools (call4me_place_call is POST /api/calls, call4me_save_profile is PATCH /api/profile).
info.x-guidance: With a wallet and no account: POST /api/x402/calls with the call (to, business, goal, category, details, on_behalf_of, max_minutes) and pay the 402 in USDC on Base. A refusal (422 "Not calling yet") lists what to ask the user and takes no payment. The paid response returns the call id and an api_key; follow the call with GET /api/calls/{call_id}?wait_seconds=30 and Authorization: Bearer <api_key> until finished, answering open questions with POST /api/calls/{call_id}/answer. With an account: the bearer routes below, and GET /api to buy credits in USDC.

bearerAuth.description: A call4me API key or OAuth access token for the site or MCP resource.

get.description: Buy call credits in USDC on Base over x402 for the account named by the bearer token. Without a payment: 402 with the price of `amount` dollars of credits.

402.description: Payment required: the x402 v2 requirements, also in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header

post.description: Place a call paid in USDC on Base over x402, with no call4me account: the payment is max_minutes (default 10, up to 60) at the destination's per-minute price, and the paying wallet becomes a call4me account. The call is checked before payment settles: 422 "Not calling yet" lists what to ask the user and takes nothing. Returns the call and the account's api_key; follow it with GET /api/calls/{call_id}. Minutes the call does not use stay as credits on that account.

to.description: the number to call, e.g. "+14155550123", "(415) 555-0123", or abroad with its country code, e.g. "+31 20 123 4567"

business.description: who you are calling, as a person would say it: "Nopa", "Dr. Chen's office", "Toyota of Berkeley service"

goal.description: what the call should achieve, in plain words: "Book a table for 4 tomorrow (Sat Oct 3) around 7pm under Khami."

category.description: the kind of call; decides what must be known first (see call4me_get_requirements)

details.description: answers to the category's fields by key, e.g. {"reason":"annual physical","patient_status":"existing","availability":"weekday mornings next week"}. Profile fields (name, DOB, phone, insurance...) are filled from the saved profile only when the call is for the profile's owner; for anyone else (on_behalf_of is another name) pass all of their details here, since the owner's are never used.

on_behalf_of.description: who the call is for, as the caller should say it (default: the profile's full_name). The caller calls FOR this person; it never claims to be them.

facts.description: anything else the caller may share beyond the category's fields, one per line

flexibility.description: what the caller may accept without asking: "any time 6:30-8pm", "a different day this week is fine", "up to $300". Anything outside this becomes a question to you.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the business, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles", so "tomorrow" is unambiguous

connect_when.description: when to ring the user and patch them into the call without being asked, e.g. "as soon as a person picks up" (skip the hold) or "if they need to speak to me". Rings their own phone: details.phone when given, else the one in their profile; a call with neither is refused. They hand the call back to the caller by pressing * or hanging up.

listen_in.description: ring the user as soon as the business answers so they can listen in: nobody on the call hears them and the caller keeps working. They press 1 anytime to take over, or hang up to stop listening. Rings their own phone: details.phone when given, else the one in their profile; a call with neither is refused.

max_minutes.description: the most minutes the answered call may run, including phone menus (default 10); the payment is this many minutes at the destination's per-minute price. Minutes the call does not use stay as credits on the paying wallet's call4me account

voice.description: caller voice (default marin); hear each at https://call4.me/voices

caller_name.description: a first name the caller introduces itself with, e.g. "Jordan", for this call only (default: the profile's assistant_name, else none: just "<user>'s assistant"). Put the caller's name and company here, never in the goal: the caller's identity comes only from these fields.

calling_as.description: a company the caller calls from, e.g. "Acme": it introduces itself as "Jordan from Acme" (or "calling from Acme" without caller_name) instead of "<user>'s assistant", and callbacks to the number it called from answer as that company. Calling for several companies: pass the company on every call and give each one its own number (from), so callbacks reach the right identity.

callback_number.description: the number the caller gives for call-backs and on voicemail, when the user wants callbacks to ring a phone of theirs (e.g. "(415) 555-0123"). Default: the number the call comes from, so a call4me number answers the callback and finishes the task. A callback to callback_number goes straight to that phone instead, and call4me never hears it. Phone numbers in details or facts are only for finding or verifying an account, never given as the callback.

from.description: which of the account's numbers to call from (default: a call4me number in the callee's country). May be one of the user's own verified numbers (call4me_verify_number), for businesses in its country: they see it and call back the user directly

finished.description: true once the call ended and its recap is written; poll until then

calling_number.description: the call4me number that rings the user when they join

open_questions.description: the business is waiting on the line: answer right away

cost_cents.description: billed so far, in US cents; final once finished

ended.description: who ended the call and why

get.description: The prepaid balance, the per-minute price (and the destinations priced differently), and the account's call4me numbers. Free.
The kinds of call (category slugs) call4me places. Each decides what must be known before dialing. Free.

The information a kind of call needs before dialing, and which of it the saved profile already has. Ask the user for every required field not known, in one message, then pass the answers in details when placing the call. Free.
Saved details reused on relevant calls (name, DOB, phone, address, insurance, car). An incomplete profile is fine. Free.

post.description: Call a business for the user and have a natural conversation to get something done (book, reschedule, cancel, ask). Refuses with 422 "Not calling yet" until the category's required information is known, listing exactly what to ask the user. Returns at once with the call; follow it with GET /api/calls/{call_id}?wait_seconds=30 until finished, answering any open question right away. Credits for the maximum length are held up front; billed per minute from pickup (phone menus and conversation; hold time at half price), rounded up; unanswered calls are free.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique value per request (a UUID), kept on retries of it. A retry with the same key and body returns the call the first request made (200, with Idempotent-Replayed: true) instead of placing another; the same key with a different body is refused (422). Keys belong to the account and never expire. A request refused before anything was placed (422 "Not calling yet", 402) does not use up its key.

post.description: Ring the user now and patch them into a live call. They join by pressing 1; the caller goes quiet and takes back over when they press * or hang up. Mode "listen" lets them listen in without being heard. Tell the user before calling this.

mode.description: "join" (default): they take the call over by pressing 1. "listen": they listen in while the caller keeps working, and can press 1 anytime to take over

post.description: End a call in progress now. Talk time so far is billed as usual.

get.description: The account's phone numbers, and the countries more can be bought in with today's prices. Calls go out from a number in the callee's country when the account holds one. US, Canadian and European businesses can always be called (Europe from a European number if the account has one, else from its US number), and UAE and Japanese businesses too, from the account's US number (the business sees a US caller ID); elsewhere, a number in the country is what lets the account call there. Numbers cost exactly what the carrier charges: the upfront cost plus the first month when bought, then the monthly cost every 30 days, taken from the balance. own_numbers are the user's own phone numbers verified with call4me_verify_number: free, and used only when call4me_place_call names one in from.

200.description: The account's numbers and the countries more can be bought in

included.description: the free number that came with the account

renews.description: date the next monthly charge is due; null for the free number

overdue.description: the last renewal failed for lack of credits

release_after.description: when an overdue number is released unless credits are added

pending_numbers.description: numbers paid for and waiting on the carrier's approval (numbers abroad are reviewed first, minutes to a few days). They activate by themselves and cannot place calls until they move to numbers. Omitted when there are none

ordered.description: date it was bought; it activates once the carrier approves it, and its first month starts then

own_numbers.description: the user's own phone numbers, verified to call from: calls go out from one only when place_call names it in from. Omitted when the account has none

status.description: pending: the code was sent and has not come back yet

reason.description: why a number cannot be bought there right now

price.description: taken from the balance when buying: upfront cost plus the first month

post.description: Buy another phone number, in the US or abroad, paid from the balance at the carrier's own price (see call4me_list_numbers for prices). It renews from the balance every 30 days; if the balance can't cover a renewal the number is released after 7 days. Only buy when the user asks for a number or needs one to call a country. A number abroad is reviewed by the carrier after it's paid for, from minutes to a few days: it comes back pending, activates by itself, and can't place calls until then.

country.description: ISO country code from the countries list, e.g. "NL", "GB", "CA", "US"

area_code.description: preferred area code (national destination code), e.g. "415" or "20"; the nearest available is used otherwise

delete.description: Give up one of the account's bought numbers. Its monthly charge stops; what was already paid is not refunded, and the number cannot be gotten back. The free number that came with the account cannot be released. Only do this when the user asks.

post.description: Send a verification code to the user's own phone number: a text, or a call that reads the code out. Submit the code with POST /api/numbers/own/{number}/verify. At most 5 codes a day.

number.description: the user's own phone number, e.g. "+14155550123" or "(415) 555-0123"

method.description: how to send the code: a text, or a call that reads it out (for landlines)

extension.description: keys the verification call dials once answered, to get past a phone menu to an extension; w waits half a second, W one second. method "call" only

202.description: The code was sent; the number waits on it

status.description: pending: the code was sent and has not come back yet

post.description: Submit the code the user's own number received. Once accepted, calls can go out from it (from in call4me_place_call), to businesses in its own country.

schema.description: one of the user's own numbers on the account, e.g. "+14155550123"

status.description: pending: the code was sent and has not come back yet

delete.description: Stop calling from one of the user's own numbers, or drop one still waiting on its code. Verifying it again needs a new code. Only do this when the user asks.

schema.description: one of the user's own numbers on the account, e.g. "+14155550123"

status.description: pending: the code was sent and has not come back yet

get.description: Get existing recordings of a finished call owned by the signed in account. Returns fresh download links when available. An empty list means no recording is available yet. Links may expire; request this again for fresh links. Only share the links with the user.

schema.description: The call id returned when placing or listing calls.

200.description: Available recordings and fresh download links
